body:
Hello everyone, Im Likoluc, a player from ocn and Im LFT
My ocn stats are there: http://oc.tc/Likoluc
Im a defender for every gamemode, but Im also a really good bridger and a pretty good offender. I have experiences with such strong teams in ocn so if you want a good defender for your team, here I am ;)
In avicus I have been on Apollo, Reclaimers and Ethernal Cross.
